build_scorm.py is documented as a deterministic build but is not: it writes files with their filesystem mtime and generates imsmanifest.xml with writestr (current time), so identical content yields a different sha256 on every rebuild. tools/agents/package.py works around this by pinning staged mtimes and rewriting the archive with one fixed timestamp.
evidence: verified by two full regenerate+repackage cycles producing identical checksums
action: pin ZipInfo.date_time in build_scorm.py so checksums are comparable across rebuilds

recommendation: Give every new runtime shape its own QA harness rather than reusing the paged one.
evidence: The existing harness assumed paged navigation. A scroll runtime needs IntersectionObserver, matchMedia, requestAnimationFrame, and scrollIntoView shims, plus a DOMContentLoaded dispatch because jsdom reports readyState 'loading' for externally evaluated scripts.
